mapping_limits.performance: 4096 and physical/policy/PPO/native source remain unchanged by this sampling candidate. Source dt/decimation is audit data, not imported mechanics.
mapping_limits.metrics: Modified forward_05 etc. now sample a continuous mixture; old fixed-command MAE labels cannot imply .5m/s tracking.
